subscription.title: Make AI logging effortless
subscription.pending: The purchase is pending approval. Pro will activate after Apple confirms it.
subscription.renewal: Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel it in your App Store subscriptions.

benefit.credits: 1,000 AI credits each billing period for workout, voice and meal logging
benefit.photos: Up to 60 meal photos each billing period, within the credit allowance
benefit.freeCore: Manual logging, local parsing, repeats, Apple Health and exercise recommendations remain free and unlimited
benefit.costs: Per use: workout text 1 · meal text 2 · voice workout 3–4 · meal photo 8 credits
benefit.safety: AI provider failures return included usage. Repeated provider failures can pause remote AI until reset; manual and local logging stay available.
benefit.consent: Remote AI requires confirmation that you are 18 or older and consent to send selected text, audio or meal photos to Groq.

data.deleteConfirm: This deletes Reploom's server-side Pro quota and request details. A one-way reset-prevention record remains until {date}; Apple test purchases may also keep one-way daily attempt totals through the current UTC day. This does not cancel your Apple subscription or erase Apple's purchase history. Manual and local features remain available.

settings.title: Settings

remoteAi.label: I am 18+ and allow remote AI
remoteAi.explainer: By turning this on, you confirm that you are 18 or older and consent to Reploom sending selected input through its Cloudflare Worker to Groq: workout text with your unit setting and exercise catalog names/IDs; microphone audio for transcription and, if local matching cannot resolve it, the transcript with the same workout context; and meal text/photos you submit. Groq's processing policies apply. You can turn this off at any time; local workout quick logging remains available.
remoteAi.off: OFF · Nothing is sent to Groq
